title: Correctness of Simon Attacks on Feistel and MISTY
summary: For Simon-algorithm attacks on 3-round Feistel and 4-round MISTY R-FK, it remains to justify Simon's promise or derive differential attacks in exceptional cases.

formal_statement.body: Rigorous correctness analysis remains to be supplied for the Simon-algorithm attacks on the 3-round Feistel cipher and 4-round MISTY R-FK. For each attack, prove the required dichotomy: either its periodic function fulfills Simon's promise sufficiently to justify the attack, or any exceptional case gives rise to a differential-based attack.

scope.domain: Quantum symmetric cryptanalysis of 3-round Feistel and 4-round MISTY R-FK using Simon's algorithm.
assumptions: For simplicity, Simon's algorithm is assumed to return the correct period for the new key-recovery attacks.
parameters: Three and four rounds identify the respective Feistel and MISTY R-FK attack targets
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove for each attack that Simon's promise is sufficiently fulfilled or that every exceptional case yields a differential-based attack.

citations.label: Simon's Algorithm and Symmetric Crypto: Generalizations and Automatized Applications

progress.summary: The authors indicate that a strategy from prior work could establish the required dichotomy, but defer the rigorous correctness analysis to future work.
citation_labels: Federico Canale et al., Simon's Algorithm and Symmetric Crypto: Generalizations and Automatized Applications
